title: Factorial staircases: a pattern in factorials, explained
description: Source files for an expository note on the identity n! = (n-m)[(n-1)! + ... + (n-m-1)!] + (m-1)(n-1)! + ... + 1·(n-m+1)!: the LaTeX paper, Python and C verification scripts, and Lean 4 proofs. Code is MIT-licensed; the paper (paper/) is CC BY 4.0.
